title: PhD in Finance
institution: Erasmus University Rotterdam, Rotterdam School of Management (RSM)
about: Full-time PhD position in finance at Rotterdam School of Management; applicants with economics or econometrics backgrounds are welcome, and an MSc in finance is not required because the programme includes a finance curriculum. Accepted candidates become Erasmus University Rotterdam employees.
requirements: Background in finance, economics or econometrics; an MSc in finance is not required

upskill.name: AI Fundamentals for Finance
why: "Background in finance, economics or econometrics" → "Explore practical AI applications across accounting, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), banking, investment activities, and corporate finance."
